workload: One row count at or below 10000. Memory SQL and memory ORM measure insert, point cold, point warm, range cold, range warm, one update, and one delete. File SQL, when included, repeats the SQL insert and the point query on a pre-created rollback-journal file. Each sample uses a fresh database.
sizes_not_run_reason: The requested ceiling is 10000 rows. 100000 and 1000000 were not run.
os_version: Linux 6.12.94+ #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon Oct 19 22:12:29 UTC 2026
cold_definition: The first measured SQL query after the fill, in the same process. It is not a new process. Image export and file length are taken before that query and are not the cold sample.
warm_definition: The next repetition of that same SQL query in that process.
population_variance_definition: The integer floor of the population variance of the microsecond samples: sum((sample - mean)^2) / sample_count.

file_sql.durability: directoryEntriesDurable true is a caller attestation on a temp file. Power loss was not measured.

limitations: Linux x64 only when the AOT executable is run there. This is not macOS, Windows, Android, or iOS, and it is not a native SQLite comparison. 100000 and 1000000 rows were not run. The ORM image includes the _sqlite_plus_orm_model catalog after ensureCreated, so its byte length differs from the raw SQL image. directoryEntriesDurable true on the temp file is a caller attestation, not a power-loss result. RSS is the whole process. No earlier binary was measured, so no delta is claimed.
